contact.lead: Email, telephone or WhatsApp — whichever suits you. We handle enquiries personally and reply as quickly as we can.
about.heading: About
about.description: We arrange tourism services between Sri Lanka and Italy in both directions. That covers planned itineraries for travellers who want a framework, and fully custom trips for those who already know what they are after.
about.feature1: Tell us your dates, direction, and roughly what you want to see
about.feature2: We come back with a proposed itinerary and an honest price
about.feature3: You adjust it until it fits — nothing is fixed until you say so
about.feature4: We book, confirm and stay reachable throughout the trip
about.whyBothText: Travel between these two countries runs both ways: holidays out, family visits back, longer stays either direction. Working both sides means the same person can answer questions whether you are planning from Colombo, Rome or anywhere in between.
